description: This file defines a Java interface 'ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor' which extends another interface and declares methods for visiting different types of expressions related to 'ExistsFieldExpression' in a query language.

classes.name: ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor
classes.description: An interface for visitor pattern implementation for 'ExistsFieldExpression', extending 'SortFieldExpressionVisitor' and specializing in methods for visiting attribute, feature, feature ID property, and simple expressions.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Visits an attribute expression identified by its key.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Visits a feature expression identified by its feature ID.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Visits a feature ID property expression with specified feature ID and property name.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Visits a simple expression identified by its field name.
